parameters.query: INSERT INTO home_banner_daily_stats (banner_id, day, views, taps) SELECT * FROM (SELECT j.bid, CURDATE() AS d, SUM(j.v) AS v, SUM(j.t) AS t FROM JSON_TABLE($1, '$[*]' COLUMNS (bid INT PATH '$.bid', v INT PATH '$.v', t INT PATH '$.t')) AS j JOIN home_banners b ON b.id = j.bid GROUP BY j.bid) AS x ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE views = views + x.v, taps = taps + x.t
